authority: Existing DatasetRegistry SQLite authority; provider-independent local training inputs only

materialized_ingestion.identity: SHA256 of original immutable bytes; exact ordered document sequence additionally binds SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON string array
materialized_ingestion.legacy_split_identity: SHA256 of newline-joined documents is retained for declared legacy trainer compatibility and cannot substitute for materialized document-sequence identity
materialized_ingestion.transaction: One SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction commits source envelopes, original bytes, immutable dataset/version and split document rows, observations, computed quality and idempotency receipt
materialized_ingestion.optimistic_version: Positive monotonically assigned integer versions; expected_version equals the current materialized version for that dataset ID
materialized_ingestion.idempotency: Same ingestion identity and exact request returns the original committed receipt; changed content, rights, classification, source metadata, split order or policy under that identity rejects
materialized_ingestion.quality: Baseline nonempty-document and exact observed count gates are mandatory; optional additional rules use stored observations and cannot supply success booleans or fabricated metrics
materialized_ingestion.failure: Malformed bytes, missing rights, quarantine, stale version, conflicting identity or failed critical quality gate leaves no ingestion/dataset/content commit

multimodal_ingestion.input: Typed MultimodalTrainingManifest plus exact ordered documents
multimodal_ingestion.validation: Verify exported manifest and every projected text digest before transaction; preserve original asset, record, projection, extractor, source, rights, lineage, simulated-origin and instruction-untrusted identities
multimodal_ingestion.authority: The existing multimodal corpus owns original assets; DatasetRegistry owns the materialized training text sequence and immutable export evidence
multimodal_ingestion.simulation_rule: simulation_training never silently grants ordinary training permission

readiness.materialized: Training requires restart-readable original content, exact document sequence, matching split observations, an observation-bound computed quality report and active source/dataset rights
readiness.legacy: register_ingest/register_dataset remain explicit digest-only compatibility APIs; training_corpus refuses to invent bytes for those datasets
readiness.fencing: Monotonic durable dataset/source epochs fence rights revocation, deletion and changed quality admission during native and neural training
readiness.deletion: Canonical local training content is removed or access-blocked and affected inputs cannot be exported or reused for new/restarted training

rollback: Disable new materialized ingestion and retain immutable legacy manifests and authoritative receipts; never restore revoked rights or silently regenerate deleted source content
